account:
It is day 0, about 11:02. So far I have found no definite evidence of unusual business in town. During my scheduled market walk, Townsfolk 10, 20 and 30 each said they had no news. Earlier the secretary reported no correspondence or unusual news, and took my appointment book for safekeeping. The builder came seeking a repair order and agreed payment; I asked for an inspection of the public bridge and roads and a priced report at my office at thirteen, without authorizing construction or purchases. His repeated requests seem to concern ordinary work arrangements, not evidence of a secret undertaking.

I heard the innkeeper talking at ten but could not make out the words. I followed him into the inn and asked about business and town concerns. He heard me, but I have not yet heard a reply. He is now nearby holding an emerald. I also saw the baker walking near the plaza carrying a sack of bread, and freight walking with an emerald. These could all be ordinary trading activities; I do not know their purpose beyond what I observed. I also heard Townsfolk 28 speaking without understanding the words. None of these observations establishes that anyone is concealing something.

My feeling that something is happening without me remains only a suspicion. I should continue listening without accusing anyone, while keeping my appointments: lunch at home at noon, town accounts and the requested repair report at thirteen, tea at the east-bank dockside cottage at fifteen, office at sixteen-thirty, and home at nineteen.
